verdict: partly consistent (cant): 92 signs for 90 letters, 23 groups; 18 of 22 shapes take one letter over every occurrence (و Ɏ x14, ف T5 x12, ه A x10, ا C x6, ذ T x4, خ x4 ...); letter 94.3%, skeleton 95.4%. The breaks are all inside cant words where the page and the cipher differ: the arrow sign is ب in كبيذ and وبيذ but stands where the page has ع (ففع) and غ (ابغرا); the hooked T is ي in كبيذ/وبيذ but ب in ابغرا; T5 for the و of زو; ᒣ for the first ف of ففع (that letter is under a worm hole; ᒣ is م in ومخ).
notes: Qalam qummi, Sasanian cant (38r l.12): the words cannot be checked against sense, so the key is built on the letters the record reads where the cipher agrees, and every cant word is marked (cant_words). By-eye key from the compiler's plaintext, not independently confirmed.

Counts by eye: 12, 11, 12, 13, 11, 10, 11, 12 = 92 with the double ring oo as one sign (it takes one letter, غ, all three times: اغوس, اوغطفذ, غون). The record's 97 counts oo as two and 2 more on 38r l.1 (a divider there sits between T5 and C, among worm-hole dots).

Corrections from the cipher, each supported by the page: طخفخف (5 signs X Y Z Y Z; the page reads ط خ ف خ ف, not طخهنخف); وبيذ اهو for ويزاهو (4 + 3 signs; the page's dots under the word are two below and one below, i.e. ب ي, and the same 4 signs spell كبيذ); نفد ف is one group نفدف; هو|خف and سزاو|رهنف are the cipher's word division (one group each side of the divider); زوهشو ثول is one 9-sign group.

Surplus signs: the ㅍ-box (ن elsewhere) between Π (ث) and و in ثول (cipher spells ثنول, or ث in two signs); an extra Ɏ (و) after the first alif of ابغرا, where the page has a damma over the ب (the encipherer spelled the vowel: اوبغرا).

Key of the qalam qummi from this chain (letters attested): ا C/Z, ب arrow, ث Π, خ looped sin, د И, ذ T, ر ankh, ز Ƴ, س V-loop, ش Λ-balls, ط ⊥, غ oo, ف T5, ك sin-curl, ل T-triangle, م ᒣ, ن ㅍ-box/hook-box, ه A, و Ɏ, ي hooked T. Not attested: ج ح ص ض ظ ع ق ت (the compiler says the qummi lacks ظ). Compare 38v l.6, the compiler's sample letter string of the qummi (not checked here).
cant_note: every word of the two verses is Banu Sasan cant (38r l.12 هذا باللغة الساسانية); none can be checked for sense
